item.title: EP1 — Vikings: Everything You Believed Is Wrong
item.itunes:title: EP1 — Vikings: Everything You Believed Is Wrong
item.description: Horned helmets were invented by an 1876 opera costume. Vikings bathed weekly while Europe stank. They beat Columbus to America by 500 years. And the blood eagle? Probably a mistranslated poem.
